name: EUR-Lex / CELLAR
tagline: EU Publications Office SPARQL/API access to EU law, case law, and Official Journal
description: CELLAR is the EU Publications Office content and metadata repository powering EUR-Lex. Developers can query EU legislation, case law, Official Journal content, and related metadata via SPARQL, REST-style resource URIs, and linked data endpoints.

auth.details: Public SPARQL and resource endpoints; no API key required for general access (confirm current limits).

use_cases: query EU legislation by CELEX number
retrieve case law metadata via SPARQL
resolve CELLAR resource URIs for EU legal acts
